name: Social handles
description: Where to find you: one handle per line (or in a row), each with a short coloured platform label.

params.name: handles
params.help: Rows of [platform, handle], e.g. [["YouTube", "@examplechannel"], ["LinkedIn", "Example Co"]]. Known: YouTube, X, Instagram, LinkedIn, GitHub, TikTok, Twitch, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, Web, Email

params.name: layout
params.help: column: one per line (a tall box); row: side by side (a wide, low box)
